description: Edit the user's own footage into a finished video. Put what they asked for into the fields, never into prose rules: kind (montage: pictures and music lead, e.g. sport, travel, events; talking: someone speaks), length ({min_seconds, max_seconds} for "45-60 s"), style_id (read browse_styles once first: a saved style of theirs (own: true) that fits the request is the one to use), music_staging_key (a song from import_asset) or song_upload: true (they have a song file but no link: the upload link takes it too), camera_sound, formats (only when they asked for a shape; otherwise the video keeps its own and nothing is cropped). instructions holds only anything else they asked for, in their own words. Clypmint watches the footage itself: do not describe the footage, write rules or ask the user how to edit. In ChatGPT attach the video as video. Otherwise leave it out: the answer has a private upload link (15 minutes) to give the user, and editing starts when the video lands. One upload per video: to change the length, song, cut or shape of a video already made, use revise_video or a direct edit tool on that video (a shape is one set_output_frame call), never a new upload; a separate new edit of the same footage is footage_from: that video_id. Like another video? reference_url (+ reference_mode clone or match) copies that video's style beside the upload, saves it to the user's styles, and the edit waits for it; leave style_id out. No footage (an idea or a script)? Use create_video. Also: purpose (organic, ad, youtube, sales_page), hooks 1-3 (an ad's openings), shorts 0-10 or 'all', clips (a long recording cut into clips alone), speaker_name, names, spellings, sound_effects, asset_ids, source_url (a public link where links are open). Cost: 3 credits to make, plus 1 for each started minute of footage and 1 for each started minute of finished video after the first, plus 2 for each extra hook, length or format and 2 for each clip; dry_run: true answers the cost and starts nothing. Preserve operation_id on retries.

camera_sound.description: The footage's own sound. mute: only the song plays (the default for a montage with a song). keep: the camera sound stays (the default otherwise).

clips.description: Clips alone from one recording (no main film): podcasts, streams, long talks.

about.description: Topics to look for first, in plain words.

count.description: How many clips (1-30), or 'all' the good ones.

shape.description: source keeps the recording's shape; 9:16 cuts each clip vertical on the speaker.

dry_run.description: true: answer the credit cost and start nothing.

footage_from.description: The video_id of a video already made from this footage: a new edit of the same footage with no new upload (another kind, length or style). To change that video itself, use revise_video or apply_edits instead.

format.description: The older one-shape switch; formats says more.

formats.description: Only when the user asked for a shape: vertical, TikTok, Reels or Shorts is 9:16; square is 1:1; 4:5; YouTube or widescreen is 16:9. Every shape to make, the main one first. Leave it out otherwise: the video keeps its own shape and nothing is cropped.

hooks.description: Openings to make (1-3): an ad gets 3 by default, the main cut counting as one.

instructions.description: Anything else the user asked for, in their own words, usually one or two sentences. Length, kind, song, style and formats go in their own fields, not here. Clypmint watches the footage itself: do not describe the footage, write rules or explain how to edit. Kept in full.

kind.description: talking: someone speaks and their words lead the cut (talking head, interview, podcast, tutorial). montage: the pictures and the music lead (sport, action, travel, events, scenery, b-roll); what people say is not followed. Leave out when unsure: Clypmint decides from the footage.

length.description: How long the finished video should be. "45-60 s" is {min_seconds: 45, max_seconds: 60}; "under a minute" is {max_seconds: 60}; "about 30 s" is {min_seconds: 25, max_seconds: 35}. Leave out when the user named no length.

music_staging_key.description: The song for this video, from import_asset (mp3, wav or m4a): a montage's soundtrack, or music under the speech.

names.description: Exact person, company and product names to spell correctly in this video; not a lasting account rule.

operation_id.description: A stable ID for this request. Preserve it on retries. Use a new ID only for a deliberate new request.

purpose.description: organic (a post), ad (three openings by default), youtube (horizontal), sales_page.

reference_mode.description: How to copy reference_url. clone (the default): deep, copies the reference's own motion and captions; slower, uses one of the monthly style copies, then credits. match: fast and approximate, included.

reference_url.description: A video to make this edit LIKE (a public https link from Instagram, TikTok, X, Facebook, Loom or LinkedIn): Clypmint copies its style beside the upload, saves it to the user's styles, and the edit waits for it. Use it when the user says "like this one"; leave style_id out. reference_mode picks how.

shorts.description: Shorts to cut from the recording too (0-10), or 'all' the good ones.

song_upload.description: true when the user has a song file but no public link to it (a song attached in Claude, a file on their computer): the private upload link asks for the video and the song together. Leave out when music_staging_key is set.

sound_effects.description: true: sound effects on the edit.

source_url.description: A public https link to the footage (where links are open), instead of a file.

speaker_company.description: The speaker's company or business, spelled exactly for this video.

speaker_name.description: Who is talking, spelled right, e.g. "Dr. Ana Ruiz".

spellings.description: Explicit heard-to-correct spelling pairs for this video, for example {"KMAC":"KMAK"}.

style_id.description: A style id from browse_styles, e.g. gold-closer, serif-editorial-launch, bold-navy-statement, crimson-serif-explainer, warm, luxe, or a saved style of your own (my-...).

video.description: The attached video file (ChatGPT). Leave out to get a private upload link instead.

voice.description: The narrator for a video made from words: matilda, sarah, jessica, alice, liam, chris, brian, george, roger, laura, charlie, river, will, eric, bella, daniel, lily, bill, adam, callum, harry (sarah: calm, reassuring, health and money; alice: a clear British educator; brian: deep documentary; liam: energetic ads). Leave out to let Clypmint pick one that fits the words. "Voice: <name>" in instructions does the same.

name: edit_video

outputSchema.description: Clypmint edit_video result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Edit a video
